text:
B: Hi, can you hear me? I'm Gemma, Hornchurch.
A: Yeah. Ryan. Castleford.
B: Okay. So what do you do, Ryan?
A: Mechanic. Independent garage. MOT tester an' all.
B: Oh, useful. My husband's an electrician, so between us we'd be a whole trades directory. I'm a speech and language therapist.
A: Right. Kids?
B: Mostly children, yeah. Speech sounds, language delays. I'm self-employed.
A: Fair enough.
B: ...So, do you enjoy it? The garage?
A: It's alright. I like the work. Don't like customers much.
B: Ha. Honest. What's wrong with the customers?
A: People argue about the quote. They think you're making it up. You show 'em the worn pads and they still say it's too much. I'd rather just be under the car.
B: See, I get that, actually. I get parents who argue about my rates, and I've got ten years in the NHS behind me. I know what I'm worth. And then they don't do the home practice and wonder why nothing's changed.
A: Same. Folk don't check their oil for three years then come in when it's seized.
B: Exactly. That's exactly it. Erm, have you ever thought about going on your own? Self-employed?
A: Bit. Mobile mechanic, maybe. Have a van. No boss.
B: What's stopping you?
A: Dunno. Money. Getting the van. Getting round to it.
B: Sorry, can I be blunt? "Getting round to it" isn't really a reason. You need a plan. Costs, how many jobs a week you'd need, whether you'd keep some hours at the garage at first. That's what I did. I had a spreadsheet before I handed my notice in.
A: Yeah. Probably.
B: Sorry, I'm not having a go.
A: No, it's fine. Chloe says the same.
B: Chloe's your partner?
A: Girlfriend. Works in a nursery.
B: Well, she sounds sensible. Electric cars, is that something you'd have to learn?
A: Yeah, if I wanted to stay in it long term. Garage might pay for the course. Haven't asked.
B: Ask. Honestly. Worst case, they say no.
A: Fair.
B: What do you drive, then? Something flash, I imagine.
A: Old Focus ST. Doing it up. Been waiting on a part for six week.
B: Six weeks! Dean'd be climbing the walls. What's it for, the part?
A: Turbo. Hard to get hold of.
B: Right. I won't pretend I know what that means.
A: Makes it go quicker.
B: Ha. Fair enough.
